component.subject: Assurance of Pardon
component.title: Assurance of Grace
component.source: Romans 8:38-39 (World English Bible); the opening clause "For I am persuaded that" omitted. The introduction and response are not scripture.

original.p: Romans 8:38-39 (WEB): For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

block.p: Neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
